original_idea: Acho que pessoas que cozinham para uma ou duas pessoas desperdiçam menos alimentos se receberem sugestões de refeições baseadas no que já têm em casa e no prazo de validade aproximado. Gostaria de testar se isso realmente muda o comportamento delas.
current_idea: For individuals cooking for one or two people, provide personalized meal suggestions based on manually entered pantry items and their approximate expiration dates, and test whether this reduces food waste and changes cooking behavior.
human_intent: Test whether providing meal suggestions based on existing pantry items and their approximate expiration dates changes cooking behavior and reduces food waste.
problem_statement: People who cook for one or two individuals tend to waste food because they lack meal suggestions that take into account the ingredients they already have at home and the approximate expiration dates of those ingredients.
actors_or_users: Home cooks preparing meals for one or two people
assumptions: Users can accurately report the ingredients they have
Users can estimate the approximate expiration dates of those ingredients
The system can receive and process this pantry information
Users will consider and follow the suggested meals
The change in food waste can be measured
ambiguities: How users will input or update their pantry data
Which metrics will be used to evaluate behavior change
How frequently and through which channel suggestions are delivered
Privacy considerations for users' ingredient data
strengths: Addresses food waste for a specific user segment
Leverages existing food inventory to create relevant suggestions
Potential for measurable impact on behavior
Can be implemented with minimal additional resources

critical_issues.issue: Dependência de relatórios precisos dos usuários sobre ingredientes e datas de validade
critical_issues.why_it_matters: Dados imprecisos comprometem a qualidade das sugestões de refeições, resultando em recomendações inadequadas que podem aumentar, em vez de reduzir, o desperdício de alimentos.
critical_issues.affected_part: Coleta de dados do usuário / Entrada de inventário

critical_issues.issue: Medição inadequada da redução de desperdício de alimentos
critical_issues.why_it_matters: Sem métricas confiáveis, não será possível validar se a solução realmente diminui o desperdício, tornando os resultados do teste inconclusivos.
critical_issues.affected_part: Metodologia de avaliação / Métricas de desperdício

critical_issues.issue: Baixa adesão dos usuários às sugestões de refeições geradas
critical_issues.why_it_matters: Mesmo com sugestões relevantes, fatores como preferências pessoais, tempo de preparo e hábitos alimentares podem impedir que os usuários sigam as recomendações, limitando o impacto da solução.
critical_issues.affected_part: Comportamento do usuário / Interface de recomendação

fragile_assumptions: Users can accurately report the ingredients they have

contradictions: Assume that users will follow suggested meals while also acknowledging that behavior change is historically difficult for meal-planning tools
failure_modes: Inaccurate user input leads to irrelevant or unsafe meal suggestions
System overload or parsing errors when processing diverse ingredient lists
Privacy breaches if pantry data is stored insecurely
User disengagement due to repetitive or unappealing recipe recommendations

Incerteza sobre a confiabilidade das datas de validade estimadas pelos usuários.
Baixa taxa de engajamento pode limitar a coleta de dados suficiente para análise.
Privacidade dos dados de consumo caso funcionalidades adicionais sejam introduzidas no futuro.
recommended_next_step: Realizar um estudo piloto com um pequeno grupo de usuários, utilizando o mecanismo manual de sugestões e o desenho experimental A/B, coletando dados de uso e de desperdício para validar a hipótese central.
tested_core_mechanism: Provide personalized meal suggestions based on manually entered pantry items and their approximate expiration dates for individuals cooking for one or two people.
reality_dependencies: Recruit participants who cook for one or two people and are willing to log pantry items daily
Develop a mobile/web interface for manual entry of items and expiration dates
Implement a method to capture cooking behavior (e.g., meal logs, recipe selections)
Establish a baseline measurement of food waste (self‑report, weight of trash, or photo diary)
Access to statistical analysis tools for comparing intervention vs control groups
claims_needing_evidence: Personalized suggestions based on pantry data lead to measurable changes in cooking behavior
The intervention reduces the quantity of food waste compared with a control condition
Users will consistently and accurately enter pantry items and expiration dates over the study period
Suggested meals are perceived as useful and increase meal planning confidence
candidate_tests: Run a randomized controlled trial (2‑week pilot) where the intervention group receives personalized meal suggestions and the control group receives generic suggestions; measure changes in cooking frequency, recipe diversity, and self‑reported food waste
Conduct a usability study of the manual entry interface to assess time per entry, error rate, and user satisfaction
Perform a validation study comparing user‑entered expiration dates with actual product dates (e.g., by scanning barcodes for a subset of items)
Implement a waste‑tracking protocol (kitchen trash weight before/after meals) to quantify waste reduction attributable to the suggestions
exploratory_candidate_tests: Prototype RFID/weight‑sensor equipped pantry shelves and evaluate detection accuracy and latency for automatic item capture
Add gamification elements (points, badges, weekly challenges) to the suggestion app and run an A/B test measuring engagement metrics and repeat usage
Develop a machine‑learning model that predicts expiration dates from purchase history; test its prediction error against manually entered dates in a controlled dataset
